alerts.intro: Every alert explains what changed, why it matters, what to do now, and who should act.
alerts.none: No active alerts on this day. Everything is within the personal normal.

ground.delayIfSent: If sent now, arrives in {delay}. A reply takes at least {round}.
ground.local: Stored on this device only (prototype — nothing is transmitted).
ground.label: Summary for the flight surgeon
trends.intro: Each line is compared with this person's own normal — the shaded band is their baseline ± 2 SD.
trends.legend: Line = daily value · band = personal normal (±2 SD) · dashed = mission event · blue = today
check.intro: About 3 minutes. Every step is optional — skip what you can't measure today.
check.saved: Saved. The engine has re-run — your Home, Body Map, Trends and alerts are up to date.
check.hr.manual: Resting heart rate (count your pulse for 30 s × 2)
check.hr.why: Your resting heart rate rises with fatigue, illness, dehydration, and as the heart adapts to weightlessness. Compared with your own normal, a small steady rise is an early warning.
check.pvt.why: A one-minute reaction-time test catches fatigue you may not feel yourself. Slower reactions and 'lapses' (≥ 500 ms) are among the most sensitive signs of sleep loss.
check.vitals.why: Blood pressure, glucose, temperature and oxygen are quick checks with a cuff, meter, thermometer and finger clip. Each one maps to a NASA spaceflight risk.
check.sleep.why: Shifting schedules, noise and light make sleep hard in space. Sleep debt builds quietly and slows reactions.
check.mood.why: Isolation and confinement are NASA hazards. Your own mood plus how well the crew works together are early signals for behavioral health and teamwork risks.
check.pvt.instructions: Tap the panel (or press Space) as soon as the counter appears. Don't tap early.
check.pvt.falseStart: Too early — wait for the counter.
check.pvt.result: Mean reaction {rt} ms · {lapses} lapses · {falseStarts} false starts
check.pvt.tooFew: Too few valid responses to score — run again for a full test.
check.crewPulse: How well is the crew working together today?
check.crewPulseSteppe: How well is your household getting along today?
camera.intro: 30-second camera pulse check: sit still in good light, face the camera, and keep your forehead inside the red box.
camera.lowQuality: Signal too weak to trust (light, movement or makeup). Please count your pulse and enter it below.
camera.denied: Camera permission was denied. No problem — count your pulse for 30 s, double it, and enter it below.
camera.unavailable: No camera available on this device. Count your pulse for 30 s, double it, and enter it below.
camera.privacy: Processed on this device only. No images are stored or sent — just the average color of the box.
quests.intro: Small daily actions that protect your health. Quests are generated by the health engine — and everyone's progress counts toward one shared crew goal.
quests.crewGoalText: {done} of {possible} routine quests done by the whole crew
quests.reward: Reach 80% together to unlock crew movie night 🎬
